messages:
Neha Patel: Quick check — we need final owners for the SOC2 evidence items by EOD Wed. Items: KMS integration cert, HSM attestation report, auditlog retention proof, S3 access review. Reply with owner + any blockers. cc @eng-infra @eng-runtime

Jared Kim: I can take the KMS integration cert. PR #712 is in review but needs infra approval on the key policy. pinging @Diego for kms-role / policy sanity.

Diego Ramos: noted. I'll review the policy today. Blocker: need the policy doc in /policies/kms/key-policy-v3.md — can someone drop a link or paste the diff?

Sana Li: I can own auditlog retention proof. S3 lifecycle rule is in place, but we need a retention logs snapshot. I've exported one to s3://redwood-evidence/auditlogs/retention-snapshot-2026-03-15.tar.gz — grabbing hash now.

ops-bot: Ticket CI-4287 created to capture evidence fetch steps and automate the snapshot retrieval. Assigned to Sana Li and infra on-call.

audit-bot: Reminder: all evidence files must be hashed (SHA256) and recorded in the evidence ledger. Example:
```
sha256sum retention-snapshot-2026-03-15.tar.gz > retention-snapshot.hash
```

Neha Patel: Timeline note — auditor fieldwork is scheduled for week of Mar 22. If any owners can't meet EOD Wed, say so now. Also Diego/Jared please coordinate on key-policy merge + deploy window (prefer non-peak).

Jared Kim: I'm in an infra rollout today — can do the approval + final review tomorrow AM. @Diego can you run a quick pre-merge sanity test? If green I'll queue deploy Tue 02:00 UTC.

Diego Ramos: I can run tests tomorrow AM. Quick checklist I'll run: - validate IAM bindings, - run local keystore e2e with dev keys, - confirm auditlog writes. Tagging @eng-infra for heads-up.

Sana Li: One more ask — HSM attestation needs an explicit owner. Alex had vendor contact earlier, but we need someone to own getting the vendor attestation and uploading it. Any volunteers?

Neha Patel: @Alex Ortiz can you own HSM attestation? If not, nominate a fallback.

Alex Ortiz: I can own HSM attestation. Will sync with the vendor Monday and post the vendor report link + SHA in this thread.

Neha Patel: Thanks all — current owners: KMS cert: Jared Kim (tests/merge: Diego), HSM attestation: Alex Ortiz, Audit retention: Sana Li, S3 access review: (unassigned) — who can take S3 access review?

Jared Kim: I can take S3 access review as well if no one else volunteers. I'll do a quick ACL sweep after the key-policy deploy.

Neha Patel: Perfect. I'll update the tracker and post a short runbook for evidence collection later today. :thumbsup:
